column1: # The gold for the precision sample (`yomhadin sample`): written by hand by the Elamur team from the text alone, before
# the extracted rules of these sentences were looked at (2026-10-18). One row per sentence: the rules the sentence
# truly holds as force:verb|verb (the act and the acts it is conditioned on), `none` when it holds no rule, and the
# authority of its law (`?` when the text alone does not say who speaks: such rows are not scored for authority).

column4: «he shall be forgiven» is a promise, not a rule
«he shall have it»: the priest's due, a right
«ye shall do no manner of servile work» forbids
a legal effect (the house returns), read as a duty
a curse foretold, not a law
«he said to them»: Rabban Gamliel to his sons (Mishnah 1:1)
in the name of Rebbi Isaac
an order of precedence, no deontic force
in the name of Rebbi Levi; the verse quoted inside
a baraita on honouring a father
